data.title: 空弦 · 回廊里的慢步
data.description: 回廊里只剩晚风。她回头向你伸手，笑着说庭院还亮着灯，可以陪她慢慢走完这一圈。
data.camera: 中近景，人物神态与互动清晰
data.promptProse: In a quiet, atmospheric monastery corridor at dusk, Archetto turns to look back, extending a welcoming hand toward the viewer with a gentle, inviting smile. Warm, antique-style lamps mounted on the stone walls cast a soft, golden glow that contrasts beautifully with the cool, deep purple tones of the twilight sky visible through the side arches, emphasizing an intimate, peaceful walk.
